title: Knight timing after correcting seating
source: Engine-arena cohorts of 256 games on deterministic boards played once per rotation, the candidate and the unchanged depth-2 control in the named slots with an ETA and a fast builder. Runs ef72f172, 647d321b, 30038304 on boards 0-63 and e79ea358, f83b1214, 1d91dbfa on boards 64-127; the corrected point is half the difference of the two knight-value pair contrasts and the turn-order point half their sum. This figure selects the corrected estimates from the original published asset knight-timing-contrasts.json; each swapped pair contains two completed 256-game halves.
caption: The corrected knight-value effect crosses zero on the fresh boards.
